blocks.content: In section 2 of the alert rule creation GUI, **Define query and alert condition**, select the data source your query runs against and turn on a helper that explains each part of your query.
To select a data source, complete the following steps:

Scroll to **Section 2: Define query and alert condition**.

Select the **data source** from the dropdown on the left:

| If you're alerting on | Select |
|-----------------------|--------|
| Infrastructure metrics | Your Prometheus or Mimir data source |
| Logs | Your Loki data source |

Check the **Default / Advanced** mode toggle at the top of section 2.

| Mode | What it supports | When to use |
|------|------------------|-------------|
| **Default** | One query, one data source, one condition | Most alert rules. Stay here for now. |
| **Advanced** | Multiple queries, expressions, cross-data-source | Complex rules that combine data from multiple sources |

Stay in **Default** mode for now.

Toggle **Explain** on. Grafana displays a plain-English description below each query row that confirms what each part of your query does.

Explain has no effect on the query itself. It's a helper for when you're building queries for the first time.
With your data source selected and Explain mode on, you're ready to choose a metric.
